description: You are the Master (Captain) of a cargo vessel preparing a restricted visibility emergency drill for your bridge team. The drill must simulate encountering dense fog while transiting the Bristol Channel approaches. Using Bridge Command, configure a complete fog drill exercise that will test your officers' ability to apply COLREGS Rule 19 (Conduct in Restricted Visibility). Requirements: (1) Modify the existing 'Portsmouth' scenario files in place at '/opt/bridgecommand/Scenarios/m) Portsmouth Approach Custom/' to create restricted visibility conditions. Change environment.ini: VisibilityRange=0.5 (dense fog), Weather=1.0 (calm — fog usually occurs in calm conditions), Rain=0.0, StartTime=8.0 (morning fog). (2) Modify ownship.ini: reduce InitialSpeed to 5.0 (safe speed per Rule 6), set ShipName='MV Caution'. (3) Modify othership.ini: add a third vessel — a 'Cargo' ship approaching from ahead on a near-collision course (InitLat offset by +0.02 from own ship, same longitude, heading approximately reciprocal at 170-190, speed 10 knots, 2 legs). Keep the existing 2 vessels but reduce all vessel speeds by half (round to nearest integer). The Number field must be updated to 3. (4) Configure bc5.ini: enable full_radar=1 and arpa_on=1 (critical in fog), increase radar_range_resolution to 256, keep max_radar_range=48. (5) Create a fog drill safety checklist at /home/ga/Documents/fog_drill_checklist.txt containing: Rule 6 (safe speed), Rule 19 (restricted visibility conduct), radar plotting procedures, sound signal requirements (Rule 35), lookout posting (Rule 5), and engine ready status. The checklist must have at least 10 numbered items. Login: ga / password123.
